meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大任务拆成可核查的步骤,一段段稳着推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务很长,需要拆成步骤、随时停下再接着做
copy.tagline_en: Break big work into checkable steps and push through them steadily
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your task is long and needs stepwise, pausable execution

howto.what: 接到任务后,它先把目标拆成一串细步骤,写进运行状态和清单里,并要求每个成功标准都有可核对的证据;长任务被压缩或中断后,它会先重读目标和记录再继续,而不是从头重来。
howto.when: 当你提到 ulw-loop、ulw 等关键词,或要求做持久、带检查点的长任务执行时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 给这个任务建目标
say.note: 先注册目标和成功标准再动手

say.text: 看一下 ulw-loop 现在的运行状态和清单
say.note: 读取当前进度与下一步

say.text: 从上次的检查点继续这个 ulw 任务
say.note: 重读目标与记录后接着跑

howto.what_en: It breaks the task into fine-grained steps tracked in run state and a checklist, and requires observable evidence for every success criterion. After a context loss it re-reads goals and the ledger before resuming.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention ulw-loop or ulw, or ask for durable, checkpointed long-running goal execution.

say_en.text: Create ulw-loop goals for this task
say_en.note: Registers goal and success criteria first

say_en.text: Show the current ulw-loop status and checklist
Resume this ulw run from its last checkpoint
say_en.note: Re-reads goals and ledger, then continues
